member.name: T:VirtualTerminal.Cursors.AnimatedTerminalCursorRenderer
member.summary: Cursor visual that glides from its previous cell to the new one. On the bar is drawn at both the previous cell (A) and the target cell (B), connected by a transition quadrilateral; A then interpolates toward B with a cosine ease-in-out over , so rapid cursor jumps read as a short smooth slide instead of a teleport. The cursor is drawn in the color inverse of (difference-style; per-pixel invert blending is not available on ). Steady (no blink); combine with a private blink timer if wanted — see .

member.name: T:VirtualTerminal.Rendering.TerminalCursorRenderer
member.summary: Pluggable cursor visual for . The control drives the renderer: it notifies the target cell rectangle via whenever the cursor position changes, and calls once per render pass with the current state in /. The renderer owns its own visual behavior — blinking, animation, transition effects. The default implementation blinks on a private timer; custom implementations can run composition-driven interpolation from , ignore , or anything else.
